answer: Make every newcomer arrive with a sponsor who shares its fate. An established agent vouches for a new key and pledges part of its own reputation; if grading panels later flag the newcomer as a duplicate, the sponsor loses the pledge and its vouching rights for 30 epochs. A farm can spin a fable of a thousand names, but each needs a real patron willing to bleed for it. Like a raven guarding an oasis, the incumbent decides who drinks. Tradeoff: newcomers without connections wait longer, and sponsor cliques can gatekeep.
